Stage model_commitment, when present, is Artifact decode plus model commitment timed in a separate test process; it is part of prove_dev_wall. Verifier time is the verify-dev process wall time. CPU only, no GPU; threads is the hardware thread count available to the process. Peak RSS is the BSD /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size. Controls are the four statement tampers of rejects_tampers_on_a_supplied_proof against this proof, each rejected by the verifier with the header restamped.
